title: Agent Work Order Runtime
goal: Define governed agent work order runtime packets so agents receive only scoped task, project, memory, trusted context, skill/tool, budget, policy, and evidence contracts while the runtime owns full registries and live dispatch remains blocked.
userImpact: Founders and operators get a clear enterprise path from PRD/business intent to scoped agent work orders without fake live actions, raw registry dumps, or hidden spend.
commandCenterImpact: P137.5 preserves Command Center UX and validates Agent Flow work-order runtime coverage, route-wide safety assertions, docs/status, and forbidden-path boundaries.
safetyImpact: Full tool/MCP/agent/policy/memory registries must not be loaded into model context. Provider/model calls, tool execution, MCP startup, agent dispatch, DB/runtime writes, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and spend remain blocked.
costImpact: No provider, model, network, DB service, deployment, export, package, tool execution, or agent-dispatch spend.
safetyRules: Do not load all tools, MCP schemas, skills, agents, policies, or memory into model context.
Use search/getContract/execute-style lazy contract loading; runtime owns the full tool registry.
Agent packets may include only task contract, selected project profile, scoped memory packet, trusted context packet, selected skill/tool contract, and budget/policy limits.
Do not call providers or models, execute tools, start MCP servers, dispatch agents, mutate projects, write DB/runtime state, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend in P137.1.

Do not expose raw private IDs, raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw registry dumps, provider payloads, secret values, mutation controls, dispatch controls, deploy controls, package controls, or spend controls in primary UX.
reuseRequired: Reuse shared/resultEnvelope.js when later model envelopes are added.
Reuse shared/modeGuard.js and shared/redaction.js for later runtime/model work.
Reuse os-roadmap/updatePhaseStatus.js for status changes when applicable.
Reuse existing founder handoff, work order, work queue, work assignment, Agent Flow, evidence, audit, activity, and route matrix helpers as evidence only.
Do not duplicate report writers, checker formatters, result envelopes, redaction helpers, mode guards, route matrices, UI cards/tabs/badges, activity/evidence/audit appenders, or work-order helpers.
